Great Lakes Family Dental in Charlotte, Michigan is located in the city of Charlotte on the border of Eaton Township and Carmel Township. Our practice has highly trained dental professionals offering a wide range of services including braces, cosmetic dentistry, dentures, dental implants, and routine oral hygiene visits. Patients chose our office due to our reputation for patient-first dentistry and a nurturing staff and doctors.

Our dentists and dental specialists provide a full range of dental services in a comfortable welcoming setting. Preventive care such as digital x-rays and cleanings and more advanced services like braces and root canals are available in-house with no need for a referral.

Our Great Lakes Family Dental Charlotte dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services.
